_about: The demo world (DBU-01): the coach and six learners at different points of their programmes. Every person, company, address and link is fictional (example.com).

TIMES ARE OFFSETS FROM TODAY, in the coach's time zone (Europe/Paris): "-24d 10:00" is 24 days ago at 10:00, "+3d 18:00" three days from now. tools/lib/seed.mjs turns them into ISO strings at reset, so the demo never goes stale.
`key` is a readable id. It becomes the row's objectId ("step-camille-5"), and a user's key is resolved to the objectId the backend mints for them.
A homework step with `fromLibraryItem` takes its brief, checklist and resources from that library item unless it gives its own: adding from the library copies (SCOPE R4).
A `file` starting with @ is a file under fixtures/files/, uploaded privately AS ITS OWNER at reset; the row holds the stored name the backend answers with.
`at` on a submission or message is when it was sent (the row's createdAt).

A check-in's `form` is the id of a built-in form (components/__cloud__/shared/Checkin forms), copied onto the step at reset as addStep would; an object is an older form kept as it was. `sendAfter.step` is a position in the same plan. A `response` is her answers (`at`, `answers`, and `seenAt` when the coach pressed Done).
